title: Derive and price fixed-owner joint P104 compensation
body:
This study corrects the entire raw two-axis Gram product at one explicitly prepared physical cut, replacing the requirement to make each local shear separately equal to identity. It derives the unique fixed-owner total compensator, including the retained caller endpoint correction:

`Cphys = [[Ar,(Ar Ac-I)T],[T^-1,T^-1 Ac T]] = U((Ar-I)T) S(T^-1) U((Ac-I)T)`.

The order of the port-dependent physical operators is retained. The factorization is division-free and three layers are minimal in the stated two-bank unipotent-shear alphabet. The four spectral sectors have `det(C-I)=2,-11,-11,-24`, so the repair cannot simply be omitted on an unchanged spectral sector. Neither fact is a native-tariff lower bound.

A concrete owned-copy route costs 32,448 rank-one copy transforms, 1,049,152 unit array additions, 21,632 private-copy halves and one peak additional private array. Under the inherited 208-call bare-channel/progress assumptions, even free joint repair has excess 832; this route has excess 33,280 before other physical costs. The general changed-profile necessary gate is `C_joint < 10,816 - 208*(mass-progress)`. A changed completed local endpoint must rebind progress and preparation.

**Scope:** the caller supplies the physical chart convention, but an actual chronological P104 producer at the prepared cut, interstage alignment, opposite native orientation and helper-bank completion are not supplied. Dirty helpers are fixed through the repair itself. No source/consumer saving, runtime gain, global supplier or new kappa is claimed. This is an elementary symplectic-factorization/operator-algebra contribution; no external payload code or local Q/D consumer is modified. Native expansion stops at the failed named gate.

## Evidence

- Free noncommutative algebra checks joint endpoint and ordered physical factorization, without assuming the two Gram variables commute.
- Canonical roots reconstruct `A^2=13A`, the complete half-coefficient support and all 104 donor columns; the frozen word is recounted for mass/progress only.
- A separate implementation checks 32 literal Gaussian-integer columns and eight arbitrary dirty columns at noncommuting varying charts, with three physical faults.
- Fourteen actual normal/optimized CLI runs cover false/Boolean/float receipts, duplicate JSON and changed/missing sources.
- Python 3.12 registered replay and exact-public-head byte/source-history preflight pass for 13 declared files. All three registered commands pass from the official read-only Git-free export, whose 14 files retain hashes and modes.
